title: Mica the Moon Rover and the Sleepy Star Trail
description: A little yellow moon rover and a smaller coral friend follow a sparkling crystal trail to a quiet overlook, then roll home to sleep under a stone arch.

Mica.role: Main character; a little moon rover
Mica.color: Soft buttery yellow body with a cream front face panel, pale teal windshield face, and a five-point white star on the left side panel only
Mica.bodyShape: Tiny rounded rectangular four-wheeled rover with identical charcoal wheels and silver-gray hubs; no arms, hands, legs, or headlights used as eyes
Mica.face: Two large dark charcoal oval eyes with tiny white highlights and a small curved charcoal smile on the pale teal windshield face
Mica.accessories: One short fixed cream antenna tipped with a single golden-yellow ball

Tillo.role: Supporting character; a smaller moon rover
Tillo.color: Muted coral-orange pebble-shaped body with a warm ivory front panel, pale mint windshield face, and a mint crescent on the right side panel only
Tillo.bodyShape: About 70% of Mica height and width, with four charcoal wheels and warm-gray hubs; no arms, hands, or legs
Tillo.face: Two small dark charcoal oval eyes with tiny white highlights and a tiny curved charcoal smile
Tillo.accessories: One short fixed coral antenna tipped with a mint round ball

settingBible.Sleepy Star Trail: A peaceful storybook Moon with silver-lavender dust, rounded craters, pale-aqua crystals, three pillow hills, a ridge overlook with distant Earth, and a curved stone-arch resting nook with two soft pads
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded toy-like rovers, cool lunar night lighting, one scene per page, and no readable text

continuityRules: Mica stays buttery yellow with a white star on the left side and a cream antenna with a golden tip.
Tillo stays smaller coral-orange with a mint crescent on the right side and first appears on page 4.
No spaceships, people, buildings, vegetation, rescues, or repairs.
Pages 9–11 share the same ridge overlook; pages 13–15 share the same stone-arch nook with Mica left and Tillo right.
Crystals stay embedded in the ground and are never picked up.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or readable words.

pages.text: On the quiet silver moon, a little rover named Mica woke beneath a sky sprinkled with stars.
pages.illustrationScene: Little buttery-yellow moon rover Mica wakes on the quiet silver moon under a starry sky.
pages.continuityNotes: Lock Mica: buttery yellow, cream front, teal windshield face, charcoal eyes/smile, four wheels, cream antenna with golden ball, white star on LEFT side only. Tillo absent.

pages.text: Mica rolled past a row of round craters, making tiny, tidy tracks in the powdery dust.
pages.illustrationScene: Mica rolls past a row of round craters, leaving tiny tidy tracks in the powdery dust.
pages.continuityNotes: Mica alone past three round craters; tidy tracks.

pages.text: Beside a smooth blue-gray stone, Mica noticed a trail of sparkling moon crystals.
pages.illustrationScene: Beside a smooth blue-gray stone, Mica notices a trail of sparkling pale-aqua moon crystals.
pages.continuityNotes: Mica alone at blue-gray stone and crystal trail; Tillo still absent.

pages.text: A smaller rover named Tillo rolled over to look, and the two friends shared a delighted smile.
pages.illustrationScene: Smaller coral-orange rover Tillo rolls over to look, and the two friends share a delighted smile.
pages.continuityNotes: Introduce Tillo: muted coral-orange, ~70% size, mint windshield face, mint crescent on RIGHT side only.

pages.text: Together they followed the crystal trail between three gentle hills that looked like sleeping pillows.
pages.illustrationScene: Together they follow the crystal trail between three gentle hills that look like sleeping pillows.
pages.continuityNotes: Together on crystal trail between three pillow hills.

pages.text: Mica paused beside a shallow crater where starlight shimmered on the pale, glassy ground.
pages.illustrationScene: Mica pauses beside a shallow crater where starlight shimmers on the pale glassy ground.

pages.text: Tillo spotted a little cluster of crystals shaped like a flower, but they only admired it without touching.
pages.illustrationScene: Tillo spots a flower-shaped crystal cluster, and they admire it without touching.
pages.continuityNotes: Flower-shaped crystal cluster; admire without touching.

pages.text: The friends climbed a low, rounded ridge, their wheel tracks curling neatly behind them.
pages.illustrationScene: The friends climb a low rounded ridge, their wheel tracks curling neatly behind them.
pages.continuityNotes: Climb low rounded ridge; tracks curl behind.

pages.text: At the top, they found a wide, quiet overlook with Earth glowing like a blue marble far away.
pages.illustrationScene: At the ridge top, they find a quiet overlook with Earth glowing like a blue marble far away.
pages.continuityNotes: Same overlook as pages 10–11; Earth as blue marble.

pages.text: From that same overlook, Mica and Tillo watched Earth shine while the stars twinkled softly above.
pages.illustrationScene: From the same overlook, Mica and Tillo watch Earth shine while stars twinkle softly above.
pages.continuityNotes: Continue at exact same overlook; Earth and stars.

pages.text: A peaceful hush settled over the ridge, and Tillo gave a small, sleepy yawn.
pages.illustrationScene: A peaceful hush settles over the ridge as Tillo gives a small sleepy yawn.
pages.continuityNotes: Same ridge overlook; Tillo yawns sleepily.

pages.text: The friends turned toward their cozy moon nook, following their own familiar tracks home.
pages.illustrationScene: The friends turn toward their cozy moon nook, following their own familiar tracks home.
pages.continuityNotes: Return along familiar tracks toward stone-arch nook.

pages.text: Back beneath the curved stone arch, Mica parked beside Tillo on their two soft resting pads.
pages.illustrationScene: Back beneath the curved stone arch, Mica parks beside Tillo on their two soft resting pads.
pages.continuityNotes: Stone arch; Mica left yellow pad, Tillo right coral pad.

pages.text: With the crystal trail glimmering beyond the arch, the little rovers let their eyelids grow heavy.
pages.illustrationScene: With the crystal trail glimmering beyond the arch, the little rovers let their eyelids grow heavy.
pages.continuityNotes: Same arch nook; eyelids heavy; crystal trail beyond.

pages.text: Under the still, starry sky, Mica and Tillo closed their eyes and drifted peacefully to sleep side by side.
pages.illustrationScene: Under the still starry sky, Mica and Tillo sleep peacefully side by side with eyes closed.
pages.continuityNotes: Same pads; both fully asleep; peaceful ending.
